```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

from src.utilities.data_paths import DataPaths

# ── Brand palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PALETTE = ["#7BB3B2", "#65A6BD", "#C997AF", "#B8B0D3",
           "#F4CF97", "#98B9A0", "#F6DECD"]

# ── Plotly template ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
_tpl = go.layout.Template()
_tpl.layout = go.Layout(
    font=dict(family="Roboto, sans-serif", size=13, color="#333"),
    title_font=dict(size=16, color="#104C52"),
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    colorway=PALETTE,
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor="lightgray", gridwidth=0.5),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="left", x=0),
    margin=dict(l=60, r=30, t=60, b=40),
)
pio.templates["brand"] = _tpl
pio.templates.default = "brand"

# ── Toolbar config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PLOTLY_CONFIG = {
    "displaylogo": False,
    "modeBarButtonsToRemove": ["select2d", "lasso2d", "autoScale2d"],
    "toImageButtonOptions": {"format": "png", "width": 1200, "height": 700, "scale": 2},
}
```

```{python}
#| label: load-data
paths = DataPaths()
DATASET_PATH = paths.cleaned / 'ces_data.xlsx'
# Load the analytical parquet from the previous exercise
df = pd.read_excel(DATASET_PATH)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
df.head(3)
```

## Introduction

This report presents selected findings from the **Tanzania Continuous Enterprise Survey (CES) 2025**.
It provides an overview of the sampled establishments — their sectoral and regional spread,
size composition, and the business obstacles they face.

::: {.callout-note}
All charts are based on unweighted sample counts unless stated otherwise.
:::

---

## Establishments by Sector

The chart below shows how sampled firms are distributed across broad economic sectors,
ranked from the largest to the smallest group.

```{python}
#| label: fig-sector
#| fig-cap: "Number of establishments by broad sector"

sector = df["sector_name"].value_counts().sort_values()

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Bar(
        y=sector.index,
        x=sector.values,
        orientation="h",
        marker_color=PALETTE[0],
        text=sector.values,
        textposition="outside",
    )
)
fig.update_layout(
    title="Number of establishments by broad sector",
    xaxis_title="Number of firms",
    height=max(400, len(sector) * 30),
)
fig.show(config=PLOTLY_CONFIG)
```

---

## Establishment Size

The donut chart shows how establishments are divided across four size bands —
Micro, Small, Medium, and Large — based on the number of workers.

```{python}
#| label: fig-size
#| fig-cap: "Share of establishments by size band"

size_counts = df["size_band"].value_counts()

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Pie(
        labels=size_counts.index,
        values=size_counts.values,
        hole=0.4,
        marker=dict(colors=PALETTE[:4], line=dict(color="white", width=1.5)),
        textinfo="percent+label",
    )
)
fig.update_layout(title="Establishment size distribution")
fig.show(config=PLOTLY_CONFIG)
```

---

## The Tanzanian Firm Landscape

The panel below combines four complementary views of the surveyed establishments:
legal form, top sectors, top regions, and export orientation.

```{python}
#| label: fig-landscape
#| fig-cap: "Tanzanian establishments at a glance — legal status, top sectors, top regions, and export status"

# ── Prepare ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legal      = df["legal_status_name"].value_counts().sort_values()
sector_top = df["sector_name"].value_counts().head(10).sort_values()
region_top = df["region_name"].value_counts().head(10).sort_values()
exporter   = (
    df["is_exporter"]
    .map({True: "Exporter", False: "Non-exporter"})
    .value_counts()
)

# ── Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = make_subplots(
    rows=2, cols=2,
    subplot_titles=(
        "Legal status", "Top 10 sectors",
        "Top 10 regions", "Exporters vs non-exporters",
    ),
    specs=[
        [{"type": "bar"}, {"type": "bar"}],
        [{"type": "bar"}, {"type": "pie"}],
    ],
    horizontal_spacing=0.22,
    vertical_spacing=0.18,
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(y=legal.index, x=legal.values, orientation="h",
           marker_color=PALETTE[0], showlegend=False),
    row=1, col=1,
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(y=sector_top.index, x=sector_top.values, orientation="h",
           marker_color=PALETTE[1], showlegend=False),
    row=1, col=2,
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Bar(y=region_top.index, x=region_top.values, orientation="h",
           marker_color=PALETTE[2], showlegend=False),
    row=2, col=1,
)
fig.add_trace(
    go.Pie(
        labels=exporter.index, values=exporter.values,
        marker=dict(colors=PALETTE[:len(exporter)]),
        textinfo="percent+label", showlegend=False,
        hole=0.35,
    ),
    row=2, col=2,
)

fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False)
fig.update_yaxes(tickfont=dict(size=11))
fig.update_layout(
    title="Tanzanian establishments at a glance",
    height=800,
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=80, b=20),
)
fig.show(config=PLOTLY_CONFIG)
```

## Business Obstacles

The heatmap below summarises how severely establishments in each sector rate six common
business obstacles. Values represent the mean severity score (1 = no obstacle,
5 = very severe obstacle).

```{python}
#| label: fig-obstacles
#| fig-cap: "Average severity of business obstacles by sector"

# ── Prepare ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
obstacle_cols = ["s9q11", "s12q10", "s15q8", "s16q33", "s3q33a", "s3q33b"]
obstacle_labels = [
    "Electricity", "Informal competition", "Access to land",
    "Access to finance", "Labour regulations", "Workforce education",
]

heatmap_data = (
    df.groupby("sector_name")[obstacle_cols]
    .mean()
    .rename(columns=dict(zip(obstacle_cols, obstacle_labels)))
)

# ── Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = go.Figure(
    go.Heatmap(
        z=heatmap_data.values,
        x=heatmap_data.columns.tolist(),
        y=heatmap_data.index.tolist(),
        text=heatmap_data.round(1).values,
        texttemplate="%{text:.1f}",
        colorscale="YlOrRd",
        colorbar=dict(title="Mean severity<br>(1=none, 5=very severe)"),
    )
)
fig.update_layout(
    title="Average severity of business obstacles by sector",
    height=450,
)
fig.show(config=PLOTLY_CONFIG)
```
